title: Context menu for scrollable sticky note text can appear far away from the right-click position
line: Right-clicking text in a long, scrolled Sticky Note now opens the menu at the click instead of far below it.
explanation: The note's text menu is a window-type menu opened with popup() on the text area. On Wayland Qt places such a menu against its parent item's whole rectangle and ignores the click position, and in a scrolled note the text area is much taller than the visible note, so the menu opened below it, sometimes at the bottom of the screen. The change moves a 1x1 item to the click point and opens the menu from that item, so the compositor anchors it at the click and still flips or slides it at screen edges.

commits.message:
applets/notes: open the context menu at the click position

On Wayland a window menu is placed against its parent item's whole
rectangle, so in a long, scrolled note it opened far below the click.
Open it from a 1x1 item that is moved to the click point instead.

BUG: 527703

media.caption: Pure master, note scrolled to the bottom: right-click on line35 (red circle) opens the menu below the visible text, over the note's toolbar.
With the fix, same steps: the menu opens right at the click.
Pure master, note scrolled to the top: right-click on line4 (red circle) opens the menu at the bottom of the screen.
With the fix, same steps: the menu opens right at the click.

review.text: Clean, minimal fix in kdeplasma-addons that anchors the Window-type context menu to a 1x1 Item moved to the click coordinates inside mainTextArea, working around Qt Wayland's parent-rectangle anchoring on scrolled TextAreas without breaking screen-edge flipping or sliding. The anchor item does not affect TextArea layout or scrolling, all menu actions reference explicit ids rather than parent, and the before/after screenshots clearly confirm the fix at both scroll extremes.

reviews.text: Clean, minimal fix in kdeplasma-addons that anchors the Window-type context menu to a 1x1 Item moved to the click coordinates inside mainTextArea, working around Qt Wayland's parent-rectangle anchoring on scrolled TextAreas without breaking screen-edge flipping or sliding. The anchor item does not affect TextArea layout or scrolling, all menu actions reference explicit ids rather than parent, and the before/after screenshots clearly confirm the fix at both scroll extremes.

Correct diagnosis: a QQC2 Menu with popupType Window ignores popup(x, y) on Wayland and anchors to the parent item's whole rect, which for a scrolled TextArea extends far past the visible note. Opening the menu from a 1x1 anchor item moved to the click (in TextArea coordinates, same as event.x/y) is the known clean workaround, keeps compositor flip/slide at screen edges, and is small and well commented. Screenshots for both scroll positions show the menu at the click (the Undo item differs only because the after run restarted plasmashell); commit message matches the patch.
